scope: Current-scan held-to-light boundary anomaly probe for page-76 O4/B4/G5/O5. Uses PDF-extracted page images, current light-table transforms, target outer edge strips, and crop-window edge strips only; no key derivation, hashing, WIF, seed, address, BIP39, OCR-to-key extraction, or broad candidate generation.

scenarioRows.topology: visual registration benchmark, not same leaf

decision.reason: Held-to-light source ink does not produce a strong, physically natural all-four boundary selector. The only all-four boundary contacts appear at a weak 10% threshold in forced/non-physical views, and no group survives the 25% or 50% thresholds.
decision.nextMove: Use the boundary sheet as visual documentation only. Stop escalating current-scan boundary mechanics unless a new source names a side/edge rule or a distinct original-layout asset changes the physical registration.
